purpose: Review a finite Campaign111 concept catalog against the complete v72 mechanism history before reading any Campaign111 source row, candidate value, comparator value, daily price, or forward return.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_return_sign_balance_238m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_formula: Across the 238 within-half close returns, divide positive-minus-negative return counts by their nonzero count.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The terminal return-sign-run definition expressly forbids changing its sign, zero, and run handling after exposure. Removing pair order to use marginal sign counts would be a same-family rescue and also overlaps upside-semivariance, signed-path, bar-direction, and opening-reference direction families.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_running_drawdown_ulcer_resilience_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_formula: Negate the root mean square log drawdown from the running close peak over the completed 240-close path.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: This changes the window, trough aggregation, and recovery summary of the already terminal drawdown-recovery family after its result was observed, while recombining the running-frontier and path-adherence families. The frozen terminal boundary forbids changing the path or trough rule to rescue that mechanism.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_amihud_absolute_price_impact_238m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_formula: Aggregate absolute within-half close displacement per unit destination-bar CNY amount.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The frozen same-bar VWAP-pressure protocol rejected Amihud-style ratios before values as liquidity, size, volatility, and direction-search variants. It would also remove the frozen directional decomposition from the terminal directional-price-impact asymmetry rather than introduce a new source state.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_amount_weighted_transaction_vwap_range_location_pressure_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_formula: Locate amount/volume inside each same-bar high-low envelope and average the signed location using amount weights.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign013 already froze this transaction-VWAP envelope family and failed support because 7,616,444 of 7,724,498 stock-days contained at least one active transaction VWAP outside its raw high-low envelope. Campaign096 separately rejected the amount-weighted variant before values. Reopening it would be both a known-failed-support retry and a weighting rescue.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_open_reference_crossing_rate_239p
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_formula: Count close crossings around the fixed 09:31 opening reference over the 240 selected closes.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: v72 explicitly requires prevalue rejection of opening-reference directional-occupancy reexpressions. Replacing occupation time with crossing count also copies Candidate49's crossing operator while substituting its causal cumulative VWAP anchor, so it is not an independent mechanism.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: full_numeric_library_bounded_simplex_refit_134f
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_formula: Refit a nonnegative bounded complete-library ensemble after appending the latest numeric factors.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign102 already consumed the complete-library bounded-simplex ridge family at three frozen penalties, and later complete-library consensus and improvement aggregators are terminal. Refreshing the component count or penalty after observing those results is model reweighting and retry, not a new economic mechanism.

next_frontier_without_formula_or_directi.economic_question: Can a separately accepted source identify a genuinely new order-flow, ownership, or event state that aggregate minute OHLCV/amount and the frozen quarterly fields do not already encode?
